text.body:
mahāyogapīṭhe taṭe bhīmarathyā varaṃ puṇḍarīkāya dātuṃ munīndraiḥ । samāgatya niṣṭhantamānaṃdakaṃdaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 1 ॥
taṭidvāsasaṃ nīlameghāvabhāsaṃ ramāmaṃdiraṃ suṃdaraṃ citprakāśam । varaṃ tviṣṭakāyāṃ samanyastapādaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 2 ॥
pramāṇaṃ bhavābdheridaṃ māmakānāṃ nitambaḥ karābhyāṃ dhṛto yena tasmāt । vidhāturvasatyai dhṛto nābhikośaḥ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 3 ॥
sphuratkaustubhālaṅkṛtaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe śriyā juṣṭakeyūrakaṃ śrīnivāsam । śivaṃ śāṃtamīḍyaṃ varaṃ lokapālaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 4 ॥
śaraccaṃdrabiṃbānanaṃ cāruhāsaṃ lasatkuṇḍalākrāṃtagaṇḍasthalāṃtam । japārāgabiṃbādharaṃ kajanetraṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgama॥ 5 ॥
kirīṭojvalatsarvadikprāṃtabhāgaṃ surairarcitaṃ divyaratnairanarghaiḥ । tribhaṅgākṛtiṃ barhamālyāvataṃsaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgama॥ 6 ॥
vibhuṃ veṇunādaṃ caraṃtaṃ duraṃtaṃ swayaṃ līlayā gopaveṣaṃ dadhānam । gavāṃ bṛndakānandadaṃ cāruhāsaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 7 ॥
ajaṃ rukmiṇīprāṇasañjīvanaṃ taṃ paraṃ dhāma kaivalyamekaṃ turīyam । prasannaṃ prapannārtihaṃ devadevaṃ parabrahmaliṅgaṃ bhaje pāṇḍuraṅgam ॥ 8 ॥
stavaṃ pāṇḍuraṃgasya vai puṇyadaṃ ye paṭhantyekacittena bhaktyā ca nityam । bhavāṃbhonidhiṃ te vitīrtvāntakāle harerālayaṃ śāśvataṃ prāpnuvanti ॥ 9 ॥
॥ iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtaupāṇḍuraṅgāṣṭakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ॥
